representation: A simple series circuit with a voltage source, one resistor, connecting wires and a current arrow whose length is proportional to I = V/R.
motion: the voltage source outline pulses gently
the current arrow length updates continuously from V/R
misconceptionTest: The arrow has the same length everywhere in the series loop, so current is not consumed by the resistor; separate V and I labels with different units show that voltage and current are different quantities.
accessibility: Every quantity has a text label and unit, the arrow length has a text counterpart, sliders are keyboard accessible, alt text describes the circuit, and reduced motion stops the source pulse.
